dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs within the first dorsal fin boundary, with clustering observed toward the posterior margin.

lateral_flank_blob_constellation.other_distinctive_markers: Five remoras are visible in the water column immediately below the shark's midsection and trailing the left pectoral fin.
